Hi Vanessa / Jordan,

Thanks — procurement here. Per FinCo policy we require: 1) fully executed NDA, and 2) completion of the attached Vendor Security Questionnaire (xlsx) before we schedule vendor-facing technical demos involving security or infra topics. The questionnaire covers network architecture, data handling, encryption, incident response, and audit certifications (SOC2, ISO).

Please return the signed NDA and the completed questionnaire. If any items are missing we can still do an exec overview, but hands-on demos or access to environments require the onboarding to be complete.

Timeline: we typically process paperwork within 3–5 business days after we receive all docs. If you have SOC2 reports or a security one-pager, attach that to speed review.
